title: France's Budget Crisis and Education Revolt Expose Deep Fault Lines Over… · 14 Oct
keywords: France budget, French deficit, fiscal consolidation, education protests, student blockades, French bond yields, EU fiscal rules, public services, teacher shortages, austerity, euro area, French parliament
notes: France is attempting to close a roughly 43-billion-euro spending gap while navigating a fragmented parliament, rising borrowing costs and nationwide student protests over crumbling schools. The collision between fiscal consolidation and public-service decline has produced one of the most politically volatile moments in recent French domestic history. The outcome matters well beyond Paris, with implications for euro-area stability and the future of EU budget rules.
